name: UFortGameplayAbility__ApplyAIFocusToPawn
signature: void UFortGameplayAbility::ApplyAIFocusToPawn(AFortAIPawn* Pawn, AActor* FocusTarget, const FVector& FocalPoint, bool bUseAttackingPriority)
inc_or_decl:
// Uses the pawn's AI controller (member at +0x250). With a FocusTarget it calls SetFocus(FocusTarget); without one it calls SetFocalPoint(FocalPoint, priority), where priority is 5 when bUseAttackingPriority and 4 otherwise (EAIFocusPriority names not recovered). Logs and returns when there is no controller. MEDIUM.
void ApplyAIFocusToPawn(AFortAIPawn* Pawn, AActor* FocusTarget, const FVector& FocalPoint, bool bUseAttackingPriority);
